name: Vercel
description: Deploy p0code projects to Vercel via Git or local builds, stream build logs, list domains, set environment variables, and roll back production releases.
longDescription: Deploys p0code projects to Vercel through Git integrations or local builds, streams build logs, manages domains and environment variables, and can roll production back to a previous release. Requires Deploy host v2. Each host account links its own Vercel personal access token under Settings - Deploy; deployments consume your Vercel plan usage.
